notes: Family Planning current-user/method-mix workbook — 5 sheet-groups (Current User Beginning=primary via CUB_Qtr, New Acceptor/Other Acceptor/Drop Out/Current User Ending via extra_sheets) all sharing the same 69-column layout. All 4 quarters are stacked as row-blocks within each single tab rather than one tab per quarter (col 4 = 'Quarter' text 'Q1'..'Q4') — period_filter_column/period_labels scope each upload to just that quarter's 67 rows (D6 mechanism, see parser.py's resolve_period_row_filter/apply_row_filter). 'OA_Qtr ' has a literal trailing space in its real sheet name (FLAG FP-3) — confirmed via openpyxl, not a typo. Quarterly only: the workbook's own Annual rollup tabs (CUB_A etc.) are NOT ingested — CUB_A's 'Beginning of year' figure silently pulls Q4 instead of Q1 in the source (FLAG FP-1, dated 2026-03-03 change_log entry), so this avoids shipping that bug; an annual VIEW can be derived from the quarterly data already stored. 'Demand Satisfied' and 'Population' sheets are excluded entirely — FLAG FP-2: the % denominator input was added 2026-02-04 and never populated, so it is structurally guaranteed to report 0% for every row, and even once populated the formula is circular (denominator is defined in terms of the same current-user count it's meant to validate against). Flow-balance reconciliation (Beginning + New + Other - DropOut = Ending) is not checked yet — the existing 'reconciliation' DQC rule type only sums parts, it doesn't support subtraction, so this needs its own rule type before it can be added (deferred, matches the D4 backfill pattern used elsewhere).
